product_overview: A cyber-arcade web app that lets users browse and launch a collection of mini-games, including a Valorant-inspired 2D tactical shooter. The shooter focuses on agent selection, buy-phase decisions, movement, combat, abilities, and Spike objective play.
core_goals: Browse the arcade lobby to find a game
Search and filter available games by category
Launch a selected game from the lobby
Choose an agent before starting a tactical match
Buy weapons and shields during the buy phase
Move, aim, shoot, and use abilities in combat
Plant or defuse the Spike to complete round objectives
Observe teammates after elimination until the round ends

features.name: Arcade Game Lobby & Navigation
features.description: Lets users browse the arcade hub, narrow down games by category or search, and launch a selected game before returning to the lobby.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the arcade lobby -> Filter games by category -> See the game list update to matching titles -> Launch a selected game -> Play the game -> Exit the game and return to the lobby
Navigate to / -> View the arcade lobby -> Enter a search term -> See the matching games update -> Launch a selected game -> Return to the lobby after exiting the game

features.name: Valorant 2D Tactical Shooter
features.description: Lets users play a top-down tactical shooter with agent selection, buy-phase purchasing, movement and combat, abilities, Spike objectives, and spectator cycling after elimination.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the Valorant 2D game card -> Pick an agent from the selection grid -> Enter the match -> Buy weapons and shields during the buy phase -> Move with WASD -> Aim and fire with the mouse -> Use tactical abilities with the assigned keys -> Plant or defuse the Spike in the objective zone -> See the round outcome and score update

Navigate to / -> Select the Valorant 2D game card -> Pick an agent from the selection grid -> Enter the match -> Wait for the buy phase -> Open the shop -> Purchase weapons or shields -> Close the shop -> Move with WASD -> Aim and fire with the mouse -> Use tactical abilities with the assigned keys -> Reach a Spike site -> Plant the Spike -> See the round progress toward completion

Navigate to / -> Select the Valorant 2D game card -> Pick an agent from the selection grid -> Enter the match -> Move with WASD -> Aim and fire with the mouse -> Get eliminated -> Cycle through teammates while spectating -> Continue spectating until the round ends

routes.description: Arcade hub lobby containing game selector, navbar, and embedded canvas games

features.name: Valorant 2D Tactical Shooter
features.description: 2D top-down tactical shooter with 19 agents, abilities (C, Q, E, X), 5-column shop, plant/defuse Spike mechanics, LoS raycasting, sound synthesizer, and bot AI
user_interactions: Select Valorant 2D game card from Arcade lobby
Pick an agent from the 19-agent selection grid
Buy weapons and shields from 5-column Valorant shop during buy phase (B key)
Move agent with WASD keys and aim/fire with mouse
Trigger tactical abilities with C, Q, E, and X keys
Plant or defuse Spike with 4 key in designated plant zones
Spectate teammates upon elimination using A and D keys
